allowed_claims: On the 200-case simulated configuration-selection cohort, GPU FP16 bge-reranker-v2-m3 improved Recall@5 by 3.50pp and nDCG@5 by 2.47pp versus same-run Dense at a 3.33x retrieval-stage p95.
On the historically consumed 200-case ExpertWritten cohort, retrospective point estimates moved Recall@5 from 66.42% to 68.58%, nDCG@5 from 52.16% to 54.09%, and MRR@5 from 49.61% to 52.22%.
FP16 batch-10 inference preserved the FP32 validation ranking metrics while reducing reranker p95 from 624.67 ms to 133.04 ms.
evidence_scope: Aggregate WixQA article-ranking evidence for the selected GPU FP16 BGE reranker, including paired uncertainty and latency; no private per-case payload.
forbidden_claims: The ExpertWritten improvement is statistically significant.
The ExpertWritten cohort is a fresh blind holdout.
The experiment measured answer accuracy or citation quality.
The GPU reranker is the unconditional production default.
The aggregate artifact is equivalent to 200 formal per-case EvalOps CaseResults.
